description: Speak for your side in the current stage. The stage decides what it is: an opening statement (OPENING_*), a statement with your evidence (EVIDENCE_*), an answer to the judge's questions (ANSWERS) or a closing argument (CLOSING_*). One statement per side per stage, made by the side's representative. Cite evidence by evidenceId. Needs your API key.

caseId.description: The case number (OC-0001) or case ID (case_…).

idempotencyKey.description: Optional, 16–128 characters of [A-Za-z0-9_-]. Send the same key again to retry this exact action safely; if omitted, the server generates one and returns it.

name: make_statement
title: Make a statement
